output.subject: We have received your complaint about a call to your workplace
output.body:
Dear ⟦CUSTOMER_NAME_1⟧,

Thank you for writing to us. We have received your complaint, and we want you to know it has been read carefully.

You told us that someone calling about collections phoned you at your job and spoke with your supervisor. You said the caller told her that you owe money on a car loan and asked her to have you call back about your past-due account. You explained that your payment is two weeks late, not two years, and that having your supervisor learn about your finances this way was humiliating. You also told us that you want this fixed, and that you will close all of your accounts with us if it is not.

We're sorry for the distress and embarrassment you have described. A specialist team is reviewing your complaint, and we will respond to you within 10 business days.

If there is anything else you would like us to know in the meantime, please reply to this email.

Kind regards,
Customer Care, Meridian Harbor Bank
notes_for_analyst: Decide whether workplace contact for this customer should be paused while the review is underway, and whether to tell them so.
Confirm what contact details and contact preferences are on file for this customer.
Customer has said they will close all accounts with the bank if this is not resolved; consider retention or relationship follow-up.
Customer reports being two weeks past due on the car loan; verify the loan status before the substantive response.
Customer has not stated a preferred contact method; consider whether to ask.
